title: paeonia peregrina proles microcarpa
intro: Paeonia peregrina proles microcarpa, commonly known as Rock Peony, is a type of plant that belongs to the Paeoniaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, and is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-boosting effects. The health benefits of Rock Peony include reducing fever, treating digestive issues, and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of the plant include modulating the immune system, exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties through the presence of bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic acids.
